description: This file is a Dart script that verifies the presence of key files in the root directory of a Flutter project to ensure it is correctly set up for CI processes. It checks for the existence of 'pubspec.yaml', 'lib/main.dart', and 'android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml'.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point of the script that performs directory checks for critical Flutter project files and outputs verification status.
